I will buy a small amount of fertilizer from the shop in town and use improved seed that I kept from what the extension agent gave us last season. Since the plot is only a quarter of an acre [wait, no, it's small], my family can manage the planting, weeding, and harvest ourselves without paying for hired workers. The rains here in Ruvuma are usually good enough, so I do not need to think about irrigation.
